summary.en: Colombian forces have intensified a military offensive along the Venezuela border after a Venezuelan airstrike struck an ELN guerrilla camp, killing combatants and civilians. The government has passed a law that strips rebels of political status, treating them as ordinary criminals, and has tightened surrender terms for armed groups. The United Nations has renewed its mission in Colombia, while the United States is reported to have participated in a bombing operation against the ELN in Venezuela. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Colombianske styrker har økt militær offensiv langs grensen mot Venezuela etter at et venezuelansk luftangrep rammet en ELN-guerrillaleir og drepte kampere og sivile. Regjeringen har vedtatt en lov som fratar opprørerne politisk status, behandler dem som vanlige kriminelle, og har skjerpet vilkårene for overgivelse for væpnede grupper. FN har fornyet sitt oppdrag i Colombia, mens USA ifølge rapporter har deltatt i en bombeoperasjon mot ELN i Venezuela. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
